name: Open VTOL ferry landing cradle
intent: Grounded 16m landing envelope with 1.2m-high support rails and unobstructed centre for four downward thrusters. Low frame stays clear during vertical ascent.

design.rationale: Grounded 16m landing envelope with 1.2m-high support rails and unobstructed centre for four downward thrusters. Low frame stays clear during vertical ascent. Handworked detail and clear silhouette keep the function legible at card size.

production.visual_review: passed: Approved open landing cradle. The card and exact front/rear assembled views show grounded base pads, connected support columns and longitudinal rails under the ferry feet. The central region remains open below the downward nozzle locations, with no raised gantry or overhead member obstructing vertical lift. The perimeter outline and side stair make the landing envelope readable. Runtime placement, clearance and effects must preserve these authored relationships.
